infotexts.JobDescription.securityofficer_arcane: A security officer who enchants chambers and ammunition. Uses the security officer tree with the Magic Bullet Hunter branch.
infotexts.JobDescription.securityofficer_mystic: A security officer who listens to whispers from beyond and hunts the deep. Uses the security officer tree with the Abyss Hunter branch.
infotexts.entitydescription.Touhou_Security_Arcane: Hold in both hands and use or aim to read. Requires a base-game security officer, both primary talent stages completed, Weapons 80 and Magic 60. Consumed on successful registration. Becomes effective next round, or on a newly created security officer body after death. On activation, lose 40% of total experience and reselect profession talents; extra talents outside the old profession tree, skills, and equipment remain. One completed transition per player per campaign.
infotexts.entitydescription.Touhou_Security_Mystic: Hold in both hands and use or aim to read. Requires a base-game security officer, both primary talent stages completed and Weapons 80. Consumed on successful registration. Becomes effective next round, or on a newly created security officer body after death. On activation, lose 40% of total experience and reselect profession talents; extra talents outside the old profession tree, skills, and equipment remain. One completed transition per player per campaign.
infotexts.talentdescription.Touhou_MagicBulletHunt: Ranged hits independently have a 30% chance to inflict burns and a 30% chance to inflict freezing. Firing a handheld weapon using a condition-based magazine independently has a 20% chance to refund the magazine condition consumed. Batteries and loose rounds are not refunded.
Ranged hits have a 30% chance to deal an additional 20% attack damage.

Above 95% health, regenerate 1 shield point per second, up to 100. Any positive shield charge reduces incoming attack damage by 15%. Each hit costs 10% of its base damage, clamped to 0.25–2 points. Falling below the health threshold stops regeneration but does not remove remaining charge.
+10% physical damage resistance, +10% burn resistance, and +10% maximum health.
infotexts.talentdescription.Touhou_AbyssHunter_Tal: Attacks inflict an additional 2 lacerations and 2 bleeding. Additional affliction totals do not scale with the number of limbs hit by one explosion.
+10% damage to all attacks; +20% TeamAttackMultiplier against same-team characters.
Against living enemies below 50% health, deal an additional 15% attack damage and gain a 30% chance to inflict 3 bleeding.
infotexts.talentdescription.Touhou_Special_Securit: +10% effective skill levels and +20% melee attack damage.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.Touhou_Security_Ma: With the Magic Shield talent, positive charge reduces incoming attack damage by 15%. Regenerates 1 point per second above 95% health; hits consume charge.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.Touhou_Security_Ar: Physical damage and burn resistance increased by 10%.
